next_steps.text: Days a tender waits for technical review is off target: 3.4 against 2.0.

summary: In the pilot. Of the agents in scope, 4 of 4 meet the bar to work on their own (Requirement extraction, Red-flag detection, Norms and standards, Technical documentation). Tenders lose most time in the queue for technical review (4.9 days per tender). About 2,952 hours a year come back, 1,955 of them in sales engineering: the work of 2.0 people, worth 293,042 EUR against a fee of 60,000. Half of all bids go out within 8.8 days instead of 17.2 (between 7.6 and 10.4 days faster, 90 % of resamples).
